home.feat3d: All money in centimes, deterministic rounding, fully audited.

scanner.allowSub: Your browser will ask for permission. The camera is only used to read the QR code.
scanner.blockedSub: The browser is not showing the permission prompt because camera access was blocked for this site. Open the site settings from the address bar, allow the camera, then try again.
scanner.blockedSubIos: Safari isn’t asking because camera was blocked for this site. Allow it: Settings ▸ Safari ▸ Camera ▸ “Ask”, then tap Try again below.
scanner.tryAgainSub: If you don’t see the camera popup, allow it in Settings ▸ Safari ▸ Camera ▸ “Ask”.
scanner.noCameraSub: This device has no available camera, or it is already in use by another app.
scanner.insecureSub: Browsers only allow camera access on secure (HTTPS) pages. Open this page over HTTPS and try again.
scanner.errorSub: The camera could not start. If it is blocked in Settings, allow it and tap Try again.
